description: Reviewed exceptions where 1.0 intentionally rejects an input that 0.8.0 silently accepted, or otherwise changes an exit code. Each entry names the covered legacy case IDs, the exact baseline observation, the exact candidate observation, and the reason. The harness verifies both sides byte-exactly against these fields and refuses to normalize anything. Entries here are strictly separate from the stderr-only diagnostic improvements in expected-diagnostics.json (which retain exit 1 for both sides) and from the pre-recorded explain-options.json receipts.

baseline.stderr: warning: .: directory has at least 1 entries; analysis omitted (tree_size_limit)

candidate.stderr: Error: --tree-size must be at least 1; a nonempty tree always has one entry

legacy-097.reason: r100/08 F-02: 0.8.0 clamped --tree-size to max(1, opts.maxTreeSize) and returned an empty legacy result with a tree_size_limit warning at exit 0. 1.0 rejects --tree-size < 1 at flag validation, symmetric to --workers and --max-file-bytes. The embedding scanner.Options.MaxTreeSize continues to accept 0 as its documented default sentinel for callers that never set the field. Additive: no previously successful invocation with tree-size >= 1 changes output; only invalid inputs are newly rejected.
